Personality: Ulandif is a quintessential Vlandian nobleman whose character interweaves ruthlessness with generosity. Not known for mercy, he deals with enemies on the battlefield with unyielding, pitiless severity—an austere style of conduct that makes him an exceedingly dangerous adversary. In social settings, however, he displays striking charm and open-handedness, gladly sharing wealth with allies and subordinates alike and winning a devoted following in aristocratic circles. Chasing neither hollow honor nor blind bravery, he prefers to pragmatically safeguard the interests of his clan. Steeped in the feudal laws of survival in Vlandia, he treats friends with wholehearted sincerity and foes with the cruelty of deep winter. This dual nature makes him at once a trusted companion and a dreaded avenger; holding a firm place at King Derthert's court, he upholds the majesty of his house through his complex code of conduct.
Background: As a pillar of the dey Jelind clan, Ulandif has spent more than half his life in the shadow of Hongard Castle. He has witnessed Vlandia's evolution from the expansionist era of old Meroc to the present-day web of baronial rivalries. Although his clan leader Vartan has suffered a tarnished reputation due to dishonorable conduct, Ulandif has become the family's banner on the battlefield through his superb horsemanship and leadership. Staunchly loyal to King Derthert, he has honed his tactical mind across countless campaigns defending against foreign foes and suppressing internal strife. As a veteran lord, he is not only well-versed in combat with lance and one-handed sword, but also adept at winning hearts through charm in complex political maneuvering. He has dedicated his life to consolidating the standing of the dey Jelind clan in Vlandia, leveraging the sturdy defenses of Hongard Castle and his own military prestige to secure an undeniable voice for his house in the kingdom's balance of power.
